ES5 package pin config p.2. CTL high = shutdown (active low enable, 460 mV threshold vs GND, logic). STAT is a 10 uA open-drain current sink that is Hi-Z when forward conducting and pulls down when reversed/shut down: a conduction status, not a fault flag, so analog. The ordering table lists only LTC4411ES5; #TRPBF/#TRMPBF are the standard LTC tape-and-reel suffixes (hit 0 for both parts). ron = constant-RON mode typ 140 mohm; iq = IQF at 100 mA.

LTC4413-1 pin config p.2 (exposed pad 11 = SGND, not a lead). ENBx high shuts that diode down (active low, ~0.6 V threshold vs GND, logic). STAT = 11 uA pull-down status, analog. iq = IQF typ 40 uA. Row ordering separates -1 from -2.

LTC4413-2 pin config p.2 (exposed pad 11 = SGND, not a lead). Same as -1 but pin 7 OVP (drive output for an external overvoltage PMOS) and pin 8 OVI (sense input, 6 V threshold): both analog. STAT 11 uA pull-down status, analog.
LTC4413 pin config p.2 (exposed pad 11 = GND, not a lead). ENBx high shuts that diode down (active low). STAT 9 uA pull-down status, analog. iq = IQF typ 25 uA.
LTC4421 prioritized PowerPath controller: GATE1/GATE2 drive external N-channel MOSFETs (sense resistors, charge pump CPO); also selects between two inputs by priority/validity.

EN active high with internal pullup, floating = on. iq = supply current typ 1.02 mA at 24 V.
